hooks.name: verify-before-finishing
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn, run lint, typecheck, tests and the submission checks. If anything fails, the agent keeps working and sees the error.

action.command: [ -d node_modules ] || exit 0; out=$(npm run check --silent 2>&1 && npm run check:submission --silent 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 1; }
